hypothesis.name: Encoded PowerShell Execution Hunt
hypothesis.description: Look for encoded command usage in PowerShell process activity.
hypothesis.reason: Encoded command execution can indicate obfuscation or malicious staging.
hypothesis.query_kql: events | where process_name contains "powershell" or command contains "-enc" or command contains "EncodedCommand" | sort by timestamp desc | take 150
hypothesis.expected_behavior: PowerShell with encoded command lines and follow-on process/network activity

analyst_conclusion: No suspicious events matched the hypothesis query. Consider adjusting scope or indicator predicates.
